provenance: New independent runs, not recovered historical results. Previous baseline matches are explicit assertions.
development_notes: Case definitions were appended as concrete pathways were identified. Every case report includes its actual intervention spec and raw SHA; source/case file hashes record file state when the report was written. Earlier runs predate later appended case definitions.

The initial4s report inherited a1.3s count window; the report was corrected and the4s condition independently rerun from initial state. Final raw output and report hashes supersede that provisional summary. Neural equations were unchanged.
No gradient training, random search or fitting loss used; efficacy/gain variants were manually specified after checking actual pathways.
All source-resolved conductance decompositions were checked against recorded conductances; clamped diagnostic targets are explicitly excluded from reconstruction.
